title: coreopsis bidentoides
intro: Coreopsis bidentoides, commonly known as tickseed or roadside coreopsis, is a flowering plant native to North America. It is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Coreopsis bidentoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
